title: FNSS support request
description: A shelter request for functional needs support: the need, the resource requested and when. Stated in terms of what support is needed (equipment, communication access, personal assistance, supervision), not diagnoses. General population shelters integrate people with access and functional needs; the request asks for support in place, not a transfer to a separate shelter. Everything is fictional and marked as an exercise product; a real helpline number never appears without the EXERCISE marking, and no real person or address is used.

subtitle.description: Line under the organization: unit, site, period

category.description: Equipment, communication access, personal assistance, supervision, medication or other

examples: Backup electricity for an oxygen concentrator

examples.need: Backup electricity for an oxygen concentrator

requestedResource.description: What is requested and from whom
examples: Portable battery pack and a sign language interpreter through the county disability services office.

inPlace.description: How the shelter will support the person in the general population area meanwhile
examples: The resident stays in the main area next to an outlet on the generator circuit.
